high_level_description: The image shows a street art piece on a weathered wall. The wall appears to be made of concrete or stone, with visible cracks and patches of peeling paint, giving it an aged and urban feel. There is a metal fixture, possibly a water fountain or a similar utility device, attached to the wall near the bottom center. The street art consists of two main elements: A stylized smiley face drawn in black spray paint. The smiley face has a simple design with two vertical lines for eyes and a curved line for a mouth. Text that reads "LIFE IS TOO SHORT TO BE NEGATIVE"
